assets.name: itemFrame
promptLines: Use case: stylized-concept. Hand-painted World of Warcraft game UI element in exactly the attached
Ascension HUD and approved Scarlet legendary UI style. Chunky readable silhouette, broad painted facets,
restrained detail, soft upper-left light, dark outline, isolated, no text, no tiny scratches or filigree
or photorealism. References are STYLE ONLY, match as one family. Bilaterally symmetric except directional
top-left corner. No green, purple or blue. Theme High Inquisitor Whitemane's oath: WHITE MARBLE and PALE
GOLD, calm soft white-gold resurrection light, small halo and feathered wings, ONE small crimson enamel
accent. ITEM FRAME 512x512 target. Square pale-gold frame with SLIM straight bars inlaid with white
marble, compact small feathered wings at four corners, small radiant halo with TINY crimson Scarlet sun at
top centre, white pearl bottom centre. Entire frame fully visible, 5% outside margin. Empty transparent
SQUARE central opening about 60% canvas width. Frame is drawn at130% icon size: keep ornaments compact and
bars slim, much quieter than reference Inquisiteur frame. Front view no perspective, actual transparent
outer background and central opening.
